notes: - **The live transcript shows a name only when it knows.** A new voice's first lines used to carry the name of whoever spoke before, then flip a few lines later. Now a line says **Identifying…** until A9 Voice is sure, then becomes its speaker in place; a check after a name means it was matched by voice, and a filled check means you named or confirmed it. The note page shows the same checks. With a cloud service's speaker labels, the window says so and a name never carries over from the line before. See [Identifying… and the checks](/docs/live-window/#identifying-and-the-checks-after-a-name).
